system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: logging-sink
    type: logging.v2.sink
    properties:
      parent: projects/${PROJECT_ID}
      sink: logging-sink
      destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/datasets/${BIGQUERY_DATASET}
      filter: 'NOT LOG_ID("cloudaudit.googleapis.com/activity")'
      uniqueWriterIdentity: true
      includeChildren: true

  - name: bigquery-dataset
    type: bigquery.dataset
    properties:
      datasetId: ${BIGQUERY_DATASET}
      friendlyName: Logging Dataset
      description: Dataset for storing logs
      location: US

  - name: bigquery-table
    type: bigquery.table
    properties:
      datasetId: ${BIGQUERY_DATASET}
      tableId: logs
      friendlyName: Logs Table
      description: Table for storing logs
      schema:
        fields:
          - name: timestamp
            type: TIMESTAMP
            mode: NULLABLE
          - name: logName
            type: STRING
            mode: NULLABLE
          - name: resource
            type: RECORD
            mode: NULLABLE
            fields:
              - name: type
                type: STRING
                mode: NULLABLE
              - name: labels
                type: RECORD
                mode: NULLABLE
                fields:
                  - name: project_id
                    type: STRING
                    mode: NULLABLE
          - name: textPayload
            type: STRING
            mode: NULLABLE
          - name: severity
            type: STRING
            mode: NULLABLE

outputs:
  - name: logging-sink-name
    value: $(ref.logging-sink.name)
  - name: bigquery-dataset-id
    value: $(ref.bigquery-dataset.datasetId)
